# The least work each nightly step does, read by `.github/scripts/floor.sh`: a step that does
# less fails, so one that ran nothing, or a sliver of its usual, can't go green. The morning report
# gives each step's count beside its floor.
#
# `key floor unit`, a line each. `--fuzz PREFIX` reads every key `PREFIX/<target>`. Each floor is
# about a quarter of the least that step did on the nights measured, which are named beside it, so
# a slow runner passes and a step that's stopped working doesn't. A step no night has measured yet
# has a floor of 1, marked provisional: it fails only on nothing at all.
#
# To raise a floor, read the step's count from two or more nights' logs or morning reports, and
# set it to about a quarter of the least, naming the nights here. A provisional floor is raised
# that way once two nights have run. To lower a floor, the pull request says why the step now
# does less on purpose. A lower floor needs that reason, and the reason has to stand.

# Proofs, the main job (proofs.yml). Nights: 11-24, 11-25, 11-26.
